newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan business group wants Asian oil purchase body.
newsitem.headline: Japan business group wants Asian oil purchase body.

text.p: Asian economies should form a body to oversee negotiations with oil producing countries, a report by an influential Japanese business group said.

The body should operate under the umbrella of the 18-member Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum and be based in Tokyo, said the proposal by the Japan Association of Corporate Executives (Keizai Doyukai).
The association said huge growth in oil demand in Asia meant the region's economies should conduct talks aimed at avoiding conflicts of interest in oil purchases.
The proposed body would also use Asia's combined purchasing power to secure better price terms.

APEC groups Australia, Brunei, Canada, Chile, China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Mexico, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand and the United States.
